question: What is the total number of sections in Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**531**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023**, is a proposed reform of the Indian criminal justice system aimed at replacing the colonial-era Indian Penal Code (IPC).
 
• The draft BNSS, 2023, contains a total of **531 sections**, which aim to modernize and simplify the legal framework for criminal law in India.
 
• It proposes changes to existing laws to ensure a more **victim-centric approach** and faster resolution of cases.
 
• The BNSS is part of a broader initiative to replace three key British-era laws: the IPC, the Code of Criminal Procedure (CrPC), and the Indian Evidence Act, with updated laws better suited to contemporary needs.
 
• The draft BNSS, along with two other laws – the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam – was introduced in **August 2023** in the Lok Sabha by the Ministry of Home Affairs.
